exceptions.reachability: deepmerge-ts is reachable only through @prisma/config in the pinned Prisma CLI. The committed Prisma configuration is static and never merges request, provider, or other attacker-controlled object graphs.
exceptions.mitigation: CI uses the immutable lockfile and a bounded runner; runtime requests do not load @prisma/config. Upgrade the locked Prisma 7 line when it accepts deepmerge-ts 8 without a forced or major Prisma change.

exceptions.reachability: mysql2 is an unused transitive dependency of the pinned Prisma CLI. This service has a PostgreSQL-only Prisma datasource and @prisma/adapter-pg runtime; it never accepts or opens a MySQL connection.
exceptions.mitigation: The lockfile is immutable in CI, PostgreSQL is the only configured provider, and no MySQL credentials or endpoints exist. Upgrade the locked Prisma 7 line when it removes or patches this transitive dependency.
